text: A muscular male figure, likely late teens to early adulthood, with dark brown skin. He has long, thick black hair tied back in a bandana. His face is broad with heavy brow ridges, wide-set eyes, and an open mouth showing teeth. He wears a simple black loincloth. Standing front-facing, arms at sides, barefoot. Other panels show side/back views and facial close-ups: eye, teeth, ear, hair, smiling and angry expressions.
